snippet.title: Fried Panic Trailer
snippet.description:
Fried Panic is coming out on the 27th of September, and it has a coming soon page on Steam! Fried Panic will be releasing on Steam and Itch, available for Windows, and macOS.
If it looks like a game you might enjoy wishlist it now on Steam!
Steam Page: https://store.steampowered.com/app/2116520/Fried_Panic
